biggest_catch: The $5 is a stock investment, not cash — Acorns buys ETF shares in your Invest account, and there is no cash alternative. It also lands 30–45 days after your friend's deposit settles.
catches: Friend must make an initial deposit or investment of $5+ (Round-Ups excluded) into their Acorns Invest account from a linked bank account within 14 days after the end of the promotional period.
Reward is paid as Reward Shares (ETF shares matching your portfolio), not cash; 'There is no option for a cash alternative to this promotion.'
Reward Shares are typically deposited 30–45 days after the friend's initial deposit settles.
Both referrer and friend must maintain their accounts in Good Standing through the reward date, or neither gets anything.
Acorns reserves the right to change or terminate the promotion at any time; promotional periods change, so confirm the current offer at acorns.com/ref-terms/.
Current standard promotion: 'Invite Friends, Get $5 and Give $5' (promotional period from June 2, 2025 until terminated by Acorns).
Friend must be a first-time Acorns user (never been an Acorns user or begun signup).

steps: Sign up for Acorns and set up your Invest account.
Find your personal invitation code/referral link in the Acorns app and share it with a friend.
Your friend signs up as a first-time Acorns user through your link and opens an Acorns Invest account.
Your friend completes an initial $5+ investment (not from Round-Ups) from a linked bank account within 14 days after the promotional period ends.
Within about 30–45 days after your friend's deposit settles, you each get a $5 investment of Reward Shares (ETF shares) in your Acorns Invest accounts.
Keep both accounts in Good Standing through the reward date.
timing: Reward Shares are typically deposited within 30–45 days after the referred client's initial deposit settles.
